additions.name: Beyond.pl Data Center Campus — existing operations (Data Center 2 and AI Factory)

status.summary: Beyond.pl's 11 September 2026 article states in the present tense that its AI Factory operates at the company's Data Center Campus in Poznań and that it is steadily increasing the GPU capacity available to customers. The campus's Data Center 2 is at ul. A. Kręglewskiego 11. This supports current operation of the existing campus on that date only; the 100 MW design scale, further high-density halls and the DC3 building permitted in 2021 are not established as built or operating.

locator.precision: Centroid of cadastral parcel 306401_1.0006.AR_28.6/2 (Poznań, Żegrze, 1.7784 ha), the parcel named in Beyond.pl's 2021 building permit for its DC3 data-centre hall at ul. Kręglewskiego. It locates the operator's Kręglewskiego campus property, not a particular building, entrance or surveyed campus boundary; Data Center 2's own footprint and the house number Kręglewskiego 11 are not separately located.
locator.identity_review: The national building-permit register (GUNB RWDZ) records decision 180 of 2 February 2021 by the Mayor of Poznań to Beyond.pl (recorded as "Beuond.pl Sp. z o.o.") for a new service hall DC3 at ul. Adama Kręglewskiego on unit 306401_1, precinct 0006, sheet 28, parcel 6/2. GUGiK ULDK resolves that identifier to one 17,775 m2 polygon in precinct Żegrze (register area 1.7784 ha); a point lookup at its centroid returns the same parcel. The operator gives Data Center 2's address as Kręglewskiego 11 and calls DC2 part of its Poznań campus; the EGiB layer shows a five-storey, about 4,303 m2 commercial-service building and a three-storey office building on the parcel. The national address-point service returned no point here, so the house number is not independently geocoded, and whether DC2 stands on this parcel or an adjoining one is not established. The operator's Google Maps embed is a viewport centre about 363 m east and is excluded.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral service publishes no positional accuracy; the centroid is a derived interior anchor of a parcel about 177 by 202 m (farthest vertex 106 m), and the operating buildings of the wider campus may extend to adjoining parcels.

additions.name: Alter GPU Center Stargard — data processing centre building (building permit 785/2026)

status.summary: On 16 October 2026 the Starosta Stargardzki publicly announced (notice NA.6740.471.4.2026.AA1/BE9 of 15 October 2026) that a building permit had been issued, on the application of Alter GPU Center P.S.A., for a data processing centre building with an adjoining office building, two MV switchgear buildings, fuel tanks, external energy storage and site development on seven parcels of precinct 23, Stargard; the national register records it as decision 785/2026 of 15 October 2026 (94,208 m3). Under the Polish administrative code a building permit can be executed only once it is final, and neither source establishes finality on this date, so the project is recorded as announced rather than permitted. No physical work, capacity, operator or customer is established.

locator.precision: Centroid of the union of the seven cadastral parcels (about 5.4 ha) named in the building-permit notice for the data processing centre. It locates the permitted development site, not the building footprint, an entrance or a construction extent.
locator.identity_review: The Starosta Stargardzki notice and the GUNB register row for decision 785/2026 both name Alter GPU Center P.S.A. and parcels 96/124, 96/125, 96/126, 96/128, 96/129, 96/130 and 96/160 of precinct 23 (0023), Stargard town (unit 321401_1). GUGiK ULDK resolves all seven, each by its full identifier, to Stargard (miasto), powiat stargardzki; they form one contiguous polygon of about 54,289 m2, its centroid lies inside the union, and a ULDK point lookup at the centroid returns named parcel 96/125. The cadastral building layer shows no building on the parcels, consistent with a new build. The investor's Łódź registered office and the surrounding industrial estate are not used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral service publishes no positional accuracy; the centroid is a derived interior anchor of a parcel union about 307 by 354 m whose farthest vertex is 192 m away, and the building position within it is not published.
